preconditions.description: The length of string s must not exceed 1,000,000 characters.
The number of queries n must be between 1 and 100,000.
Each query string xi must be non-empty.
The total length of all query strings xi must not exceed 1,000,000 characters.

postconditions.description: The output must contain the counts of cyclical isomorphic substrings for each query, one per line.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in results)
postconditions.description: Each count in the output must be a non-negative integer.

raw_response: {"interface":{"mode":"stdin_stdout","signature":"stdin -> stdout"},"preconditions":[{"id":"P1","expression":"len(s) <= 10**6","description":"The length of string s must not exceed 1,000,000 characters."},{"id":"P2","expression":"1 <= n <= 10**5","description":"The number of queries n must be between 1 and 100,000."},{"id":"P3","expression":"all(len(xi) > 0 for xi in queries)","description":"Each query string xi must be non-empty."},{"id":"P4","expression":"sum(len(xi) for xi in queries) <= 10**6","description":"The total length of all query strings xi must not exceed 1,000,000 characters."}],"postconditions":[{"id":"Q1","expression":"stdout == '\\n'.join(str(count) for count in results)","description":"The output must contain the counts of cyclical isomorphic substrings for each query, one per line."},{"id":"Q2","expression":"all(isinstance(count, int) and count >= 0 for count in results)","description":"Each count in the output must be a non-negative integer."}],"invariants":[]}
